import os,sys,ctypes,hashlib,json
fd=os.open('/own/disk.qcow2',os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
try:
 with open('/input','rb') as src:
  while True:
   data=src.read(65536)
   if not data:break
   os.write(fd,data)
 size=os.lseek(fd,0,os.SEEK_CUR);assert size<4<<20
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
 assert libc.fallocate(fd,1,ctypes.c_longlong(0),ctypes.c_longlong(2<<30))==0,ctypes.get_errno()
 assert os.fstat(fd).st_size==size
 os.fchown(fd,1000,1000);os.fsync(fd)
finally:os.close(fd)
with open('/own/disk.qcow2','rb') as src:h=hashlib.file_digest(src,'sha256').hexdigest()
print(json.dumps(dict(bytes=size,sha256=h,preallocated_bytes=2<<30,keep_size=True)))
